speaker: RADIO
text: ...Vale. Vale, do you copy...

speaker: RADIO — YOUR VOICE
text: "Mainland, this is Vale. I'm on the dock. There's nobody here."
(You haven't said that yet.)

speaker: RADIO — A WOMAN
text: "Did you leave the station key with the clock?"

speaker: RADIO — A MAN
text: "Where else? It's the only thing in Vey that keeps time."

speaker: RADIO — A WOMAN
text: "Then go to the blue house and take it before the bell."

speaker: VOICES — FROM THE BLUE HOUSE
text: "...the only thing in Vey that keeps time."

speaker: RADIO
text: Report received. Mainland copies, Vey.

speaker: RADIO — YOUR VOICE
text: "Don't go into the caves. It's already down there. It heard you coming."
(Below the cliffs, the sea is pulling away from the island.)

speaker: TAPE — YOUR VOICE
text: "Elias. If you're hearing this, you've already chosen once."

speaker: TAPE — YOUR VOICE
text: "Don't listen to the other tape. Whatever it told you—"
(The tape ends in thirteen seconds of nothing.)

speaker: TAPE — YOUR VOICE
text: "Send it. Whatever it costs. Someone has to know what's out here."

speaker: TAPE — YOUR VOICE
text: "And don't trust the tape upstairs. That one's lying."

speaker: TRANSMITTER
text: Carrier locked. Sending the Vey Isle report to the mainland.

speaker: RADIO — MAINLAND
text: "Vey, we copy. We... copy."
(Every radio on the island answers at once, in your voice.)

speaker: RADIO — SUHA
text: "Elias? It's me. Did you land yet? You forgot your scarf again. I'm wearing it, so it's mine now."
(Suha. The radio shouldn't reach that far.)

speaker: RADIO — SUHA
text: "Hey, it's me again. Remember the ferry, when the lights went out and you said you weren't scared?"

speaker: RADIO — SUHA
text: "Be careful out there. Come home soon."

speaker: RADIO — SUHA
text: "Elias. Listen to me. None of this is real. You fell asleep on the boat. You're dreaming."

speaker: RADIO — SUHA
text: "I love you the most... Come to the top. Don't press it. Listen to me."

speaker: RADIO — SUHA
text: "Don't touch that machine. Come up to the top of the lighthouse — to the light. I'm there. I'll wake you up."

speaker: RADIO — SUHA
text: "Come home to me."

speaker: SUHA
text: "You came. I knew you would. You always come back to me."

speaker: ELIAS
text: Suha... I'm so tired. Wake me up.

speaker: SUHA
text: "Shh. Don't turn the light off. Not ever."
(She turns around.)

speaker: THE ISLAND — IN HER VOICE
text: "There was never anyone waiting for you, Elias. You drowned at 03:12. We only needed someone to keep the light."
(Your recorder clicks on by itself. RECORDING 1 OF 1 — 00:13.)
(Thirteen seconds of nothing. Then, very faintly, someone breathing out.)

speaker: RADIO — VERY QUIET
text: "...three more steps."

speaker: RADIO — YOUR VOICE
text: "Mainland, this is Vale. Report sent. I'm leaving the island."

speaker: ELIAS
text: Mainland, this is Vale. Report sent. I'm leaving the—

speaker: RADIO — YOUR VOICE
text: "—it's on the boat."

speaker: A VOICE — UNDER THE DOCK
text: "...Elias, it's cold down here..."

speaker: ELIAS
text: That was my voice. I haven't said that yet.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Footsteps behind me... my footsteps. They kept going after I stopped.

speaker: ELIAS
text: A field recorder. Someone left it here for me.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Under the hiss — my footsteps again. And my voice.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Lights in the windows. No power lines. No people.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Something's standing on the lighthouse road. Too tall to be a man.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The tea's still warm. The chair is turned to face the wall.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The station key. The clock is running backwards around it.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The bell just rang. It isn't moving.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The weather station. Lights on, report sent, then I'm gone.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The sea is pulling away from the island. That isn't possible.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Something is clicking up in the trees.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Kell's hut. Tally marks on every wall — hours.

speaker: ELIAS
text: He's up there. Hanging. Breathing like a man asleep.

speaker: ELIAS
text: He's awake! The tower floodlight — light hurts him!

speaker: ELIAS
text: In the light he looked like a man again. I'm sorry, Tomas.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The Pelagic. And every boat that came looking for her.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Oh God. They kept the crew in the hold.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Low Vey. The drowned village. The tide brought it back.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The caves the radio warned me about. Of course I'm going in.

speaker: ELIAS
text: A hospital. Under the sea.

speaker: ELIAS
text: They cut into people's ears. To make them hear the island.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Two tapes, both in my voice, telling me opposite things.

speaker: ELIAS
text: This is it. This is what's been calling.

speaker: ELIAS
text: ...Who's there?

speaker: ELIAS
text: Someone just said my name. From under the dock.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Knocking. From inside. It's a child's knock.

speaker: ELIAS
text: There was someone behind me in the mirror. There's no one here.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Someone's climbing the stairs. I haven't moved.

speaker: ELIAS
text: A bell. Out there, under the water.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Thirteen. It rang thirteen times.

speaker: WHISPER
text: "...you already opened it, Elias. You just don't remember yet..."

speaker: WHISPER
text: "...don't look at the light. It looks back..."

speaker: WHISPER
text: "...you said this already. Tonight. Again..."

speaker: WHISPER
text: "...it isn't behind you. I am..."

speaker: WHISPER
text: "...three more steps..."

speaker: WHISPER
text: "...they cut my ears so I could hear you coming..."

speaker: REC_morrow_tape
text: [Dr. Morrow: 'Subject Kell can hear the thirteen seconds coming. He says it is not silence. He says it is someone holding their breath.']

speaker: REC_mayday
text: [a ship's radio: 'Mayday, Pelagic... we hear the island answering... it is asking us to come closer...']

speaker: REC_kell_tape
text: [Kell, in a human voice for the last time: 'If you play all three into the transmitter, it will hear its own silence. Then it will stop calling us.']

speaker: WHISPER
text: ...don't let it hear you twice...
